newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-PBL to manage Sydney Casino.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-PBL to manage Sydney Casino.

text.p: Kerry Packer's Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd (PBL) said on Monday it plans to buy 10 percent of Sydney Harbour Casino Holdings Ltd from Showboat Inc and take management control of the casino facility.
PBL said in a statement it would acquire from Showboat about 55 million ordinary shares of Sydney Harbour Casino, or about 10 percent of the issued voting shares, at A$1.85 per share.
PBL said it would pay a A$240 million fee for management control of the casino.
PBL said the transaction also involved PBL granting a put to Showboat to sell to PBL an additional 54 million ordinary shares at A$1.85 per share until March 31, 1999.

"The transaction is subject to the execution of definitive agreements, the receipt of all necessary government and regulatory consents and approvals, certain third party consents and the fulfilment of other closing conditions," PBL said.

PBL said Sydney Harbour Casino had not been involved in negotiations for the deal and its agreement would be required. Consents and approvals would also be required from the New South Wales Casino Control Authority, it said.

PBL said a Showboat subsidiary would continue to own about 80 million Sydney Harbour Casino (SHC) shares and the existing option to purchase about 37.4 million SHC shares at A$1.15 per share, between July 1, 1998 and June 30, 2000.
PBL chairman Brian Powers said PBL's investment both in the management contract and the shares of Sydney Harbour Casino would show very attractive financial returns over time.

"This transaction represents a major move into the gaming industry for PBL and provides us with an ideal base from which to build a substantial business in this dynamic industry," he said in the statement.

"This advances our strategic goal of building a third core business alongside our television and publishing businesses," Powers said. PBL's investment of A$340 million would be funded out of existing bank lines, he said.

Showboat President and Chief Executive Officer Kell Houssels said in the statement the transaction provided an opportunity to realise a superior return on its investment, while maintaining a major ownership position in the Sydney casino.
Kerry Packer, Australia's richest man, a well-known patron of casinos, also has about 50 million shares in Crown Ltd, which operates the Melbourne casino.

The Sydney Casino is currently operating a temporary casino and is due to open an A$1 billion permanent facility later this year. Sydney Harbour Casino shares closed six cents higher at A$1.93 on Friday.
